messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Wilson,

Your executive recruiting work across energy, oil and gas, chemical, manufacturing and energy transition aligns with my leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where industrial and energy growth require regulatory coordination, stakeholder trust and responsible development. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
